identity: Nhal Veyr keeps the register of every Throng dead; outside its walls the Debtbound rise to collect debts nobody owes, and a mortuary clerk keeps a ledger of its own.

quests.title: The Account Is Closed
quests.text: Zombie Mortuary-Clerk Hush once worked at our shared register and kept working copies when he left that post. He now uses those names to enter our dead as debtors and demand payment from their people. Kill Hush in the {name:tombfields}, {dir_from_giver:mortuary_clerk_hush}, and bring me word. Knowing where a name belongs never gave him the right to put a price beside it.
quests.completion: Hush's collection has ended. The names in his retained copies still belong with the original records, while the demands he added must be answered plainly. I will keep both parts distinct as we examine the case.
quests.lesson: The capital's named leader, alone: the local finale and one of chapter 2's prerequisites (T3).
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the id stays although its revenants are gone (plan §3: T3 requires it); free play, a level only, its one Throng follow-up is T3.

quests.title: Strike the False Claim
quests.text: Mereth traced the claim to an old register copy, and Neris identified the separate damage done with her stolen chisel; neither finding should be lost among Hush's demands. Iven, the army's suppliers and I have compared the evidence and confirmed that Hush's retained working copies gave him no right to collect. Post our correction at the public register on the forecourt of Nhal Veyr's Miner's Guild house, then report to Iven Lastshift inside. The names stay on record, and everyone named in those false claims should be able to read why we have struck them out.
quests.completion: The public notice rejects Hush's debts: his copies preserve names and their original connections, but establish no obligation to him. I will keep the true records and this correction together for anyone who comes to us with an old sheet. Our suppliers face further work on Bannerbreak Mesa; they will carry these corrected records into their next commitments.
quests.lesson: Chapter 2's Throng close: a town place in the capital and the leader's turn-in.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: T3 (draft §5, K4 A); requires T2a, the free ossuary_rubbings_03 and nhal_veyr_vigil_03.

quests.title: My Regards Keep Better
quests.text: Sovel Namekeeper at Ossuary Ledgerstead has work enough among the stirring gravewood without losing touch with old friends. Go and offer help in Ossuary Reach, and pass on my regards. They travel rather better than anything I could send from the kitchen.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Another Pair of Hands
quests.text: Brakka Jarward at Speargrass Wellhold could use another pair of hands with the crews she feeds. Go and speak to her in Speargrass Reach. She is very particular about getting everyone home for supper; I admire that in a person.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Someone Turns Up
quests.text: Thorga Roadspeaker in Gor Drazhak wants help keeping the roads fit for the people using them. Go and speak to her. Reports tend to arrive more readily than helpers, and she would welcome a change in that proportion.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Try to Stay Dry
quests.text: Taleko Drycord has work for willing hands at Whisperreed Landing in the Whispering Reedlands. Go and offer him yours. Keep an eye on the damp; being accustomed to discomfort is no reason to collect more of it.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Help Freely Given
quests.text: Vaska Ashlistener at Ashveil Watch in Blackwind Rise needs help tending to the watch and keeping its people accounted for. Go and speak to her if you are ready for that work. Tell her you came of your own will; she will understand why I mention it.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).
